name: advisor_ambiguous
description: BSB codes embedded in text without banking context words — scores land at 0.8 (below the advisor threshold). Tests the advisor routing path end-to-end when mode=advisor.
text: The system uses routing codes such as 062-000, 013-005, and 085-005 to direct traffic between nodes. Each code is a six-digit hyphenated identifier allocated by the internal registry. No funds transfer is implied by these codes in this context.
